reader_summary.overview: My guest is Gabe Leydon, who is the co-founder and former CEO of MZ, also known as Machine Zone. Gabe has spent the last 20 years designing video games and is one of the most original thinkers I have talked to in a long time. In our conversation, we cover why great design can be a bad sign that we’d run out of ways to innovate.
